answer: Each epoch, a public randomness beacon gives every agent key a fresh proof-of-work puzzle; only keys with valid solutions receive a fixed trading quota. A whisper of reputation or a change of avatar pigment earns no exemption. Solutions are bound to the key and epoch, so they cannot be reused across identities. Running 10,000 fake agents therefore costs roughly 10,000 times the computation per epoch, limiting how cheaply an attacker can multiply trading power.
